## nodes
footer: f filter | o sort | S schema | ? help
[Global]
  1                        Nodes
  2                        Tree
  3                        Findings
  4                        Provenance
  5                        Graph
  Q/Ctrl-C                 Quit
  q                        Back / quit
  /                        Search
  n/N                      Next/prev match
  e                        Edit (owner tool, else $EDITOR)
  A                        Note on finding (notes file)
  c                        Comment (owner tool)
  s                        Change state (owner tool)
  a                        Assign (owner tool)
  t                        Tag (owner tool)
  !                        Owner actions
  p                        Preview file
  f                        Kind filter
  j/k ↓/↑                  Down / up
  l/h →/←                  Deeper / back
  g/G Home/End             Top / bottom
  PgDn/PgUp Ctrl-D/Ctrl-U  Page down / up
  .                        Toggle suppressed
  r                        Reload register
  R                        Reload profile and register
  ?                        This help
[Node list]
  Enter                    Open detail
  Tab                      Focus detail
  o                        Cycle sort
  S                        Schema view

## graph
footer: f filter | d direction | +/- radius | F edge filter | C columns | ? help

  2                        Tree
  3                        Findings
  4                        Provenance
  5                        Graph
  Q/Ctrl-C                 Quit
  q                        Back / quit
  /                        Search
  n/N                      Next/prev match
  e                        Edit (owner tool, else $EDITOR)
  A                        Note on finding (notes file)
  c                        Comment (owner tool)
  s                        Change state (owner tool)
  a                        Assign (owner tool)
  t                        Tag (owner tool)
  !                        Owner actions

  f                        Kind filter

  l/h →/←                  Deeper / back

  PgDn/PgUp Ctrl-D/Ctrl-U  Page down / up
  .                        Toggle suppressed
  r                        Reload register
  R                        Reload profile and register
  ?                        This help
[Graph]
  Enter                    Re-center on node
  Backspace                Back (pop center)
  Tab                      Toggle detail
  +/-                      Depth radius
  F                        Edge-kind filter
  d                        Toggle direction
  C                        Cycle columns
  &/Ctrl-F                 Toggle search filter
